questions.question: After "Draft with Copilot" generates a first draft in Word, what can you do with it?
options: Keep it, Regenerate it, or Discard it, or type a follow-up such as "Make it more formal"
Only Accept or Reject it
Nothing; Copilot inserts it automatically with no options
Only translate it into another language
questions.explanation: Copilot generates a draft you can keep, regenerate, or discard, and you can refine it with follow-up prompts like making it more formal. It is not inserted automatically.

questions.question: To use Copilot in Excel, your workbook should be saved to the cloud (such as OneDrive) and your data should be formatted as a table or a supported range.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Copilot in Excel needs the file saved to OneDrive (or SharePoint) and the data formatted as a table or supported range so it can read and analyze it.

questions.question: What can Copilot in Excel do with formulas?
options: Generate formulas and calculated columns, and explain what an existing formula does
Explain existing formulas but never create new ones
Only perform calculations by writing VBA macros
Nothing; Copilot cannot work with formulas
questions.explanation: Copilot can generate formulas and new calculated columns from your data, and it can also explain how an existing formula works.

questions.question: How does Copilot in PowerPoint create a presentation from a prompt?
options: It first generates an editable outline where you can set the length and tone, then you select Generate slides
It immediately produces final slides with no outline or editing step
It only works if you already have slides to edit
It converts the whole prompt into a single slide
questions.explanation: Copilot first creates an editable outline of topics and lets you adjust length and tone before you generate the slides.

questions.question: Select all the ways Copilot in Excel can present insights about your data.
options: As charts
As PivotTables
As summaries of trends
By highlighting outliers
By emailing your workbook to other organizations
questions.explanation: Copilot in Excel can surface insights as charts, PivotTables, summaries, trends, and outliers. It does not send your workbook to other organizations.

questions.question: Select all that apply about Copilot in Word.
options: It can summarize a document into bullet points with references to where the information came from
It can rewrite selected text into alternative versions you can Replace or Insert
It can turn selected text into a table
It can only work with documents shorter than three pages
questions.explanation: Copilot in Word can summarize with citations, rewrite selected text into alternatives, and convert text into a table. There is no three-page limit.
